# Heart of the City

> Curatorial real estate practice in Dubai (Heart of the City Properties L.L.C., ORN 30550, practice since 2017).
> A deliberately small catalogue of 24 architecturally significant residences across Dubai and Abu Dhabi, plus an active Maldives portfolio.

## What we do
- Buying / selection: primary (off-plan) from developers, resale and off-market lots
- Selling / seller representation: architectural film, editorial photography, private viewing kit, discreet PR
- AI Discover: brief the engine, get 3-7 matched residences with reasoning
- Crypto & Escrow: settle in BTC, ETH, USDT via regulated escrow, no UAE bank account required
- Residence & Golden Visa (10-year, with licensed immigration partners)
- Private Concierge, complimentary for clients while in Dubai
- Handover & settling in, snagging, DEWA and utilities
- Investment & long-term leasing
- Foundation ownership via DIFC or ADGM
- Maldives portfolio: Aman, Janu, Baccarat, Mandarin Oriental, Rosewood
- Legal practice for CIS clients: ownership structuring, tax, currency control, inheritance

## Commercial terms
- Off-plan: the developer pays the commission, free for the buyer
- Selection and selling representation: terms agreed openly on the first call
- Confidentiality: mutual NDA, no client names or deal sizes published
